name: UniCon
blurb: Latvia's own Comic Con in Riga since 2013, covering cosplay, anime, gaming, comics, esports and tabletop RPGs across two annual festivals.

editions.evidence: Homepage key visual and hero text: 'UNICON WINTER ... INTERNATIONAL EXHIBITION CENTER RIGA, KIPSALA 8 - 10 JANUARY 2027', with a live countdown (95d as of 2026-10-05, landing on 2027-01-08).

notes: UniCon runs 'two big annual festivals' per its own FAQ (About section: 'from our two big annual festivals to monthly community events'): the long-running summer UniCon (the 2026 edition ran 14-16 August 2026, per WebSearch — already before today's window, so not listed) and a new UniCon Winter, first held January 2027, which is the edition on the current homepage. No August/summer 2027 date is announced yet, so only Winter 2027 is listed; a future pass should add the next summer edition once it appears. Guests are listed by their stage/cosplay handles (Mion, Amedoll, Zachibee, Penumbra, Wynter, Machudraw, etc.) rather than full legal names because that is how the convention itself bills and bios them (V-Tubers, cosplayers and a K-pop group member). Three guest-card image candidates (picks' #5, #10, #15, #20, #22, #25, #27, #29, #36, #41) measured 0x0 at scrape time (lazy-loaded thumbnails) but carry a real CDN image URL and the matching name/bio caption, so they were used; #24 (Steph) and #35 (Mmagurro) had no bio-caption candidate, so their 'known for' text comes from the guest-page nav links instead ('Steph — Cosplay Performer / Dancer', 'Mmagurro — Digital illustrator / Merch Artist'). Could not confirm a separate organizing-company legal name within budget, so organizer is left blank.
